approval_reference: The maintainer approved this archive on 15 November 2026 and confirmed permission for public redistribution of its GMDN material on 23 November 2026.
source_authority: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, openFDA
pretty_name: Global Medicines Atlas openFDA bulk archive 2026-10-30
description: The complete openFDA bulk download snapshot taken on 30 October 2026: every recorded download.open.fda.gov partition across 31 openFDA endpoints, stored as unmodified source JSON zip files with the per-partition acquisition receipts.
fields_and_transformations: No transformation: each payload is the byte-for-byte JSON zip served for one recorded partition URL, and each receipt records that URL, the attempt outcome and the retrieved size.

rights.licence: CC0 1.0 for content covered by the openFDA dedication. Global Medical Device Nomenclature (GMDN) material in the device identifier ZIPs is separately licensed by The GMDN Agency.
rights.attribution: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, openFDA (https://open.fda.gov/apis/)
rights.redistribution: The maintainer confirmed permission to publish the unmodified GMDN material in this archive. Downstream use of GMDN material is subject to its separate licence. Retain FDA attribution and the source URLs.

endpoint_coverage.completion_note: Four partitions that failed during the original acquisition were re-fetched from their recorded URLs on 15 November 2026 and verified against the recorded Content-Length before publication.

not_included: No parsing, reshaping, harmonisation or cross-source matching; these are raw source partitions.
No claim that these 31 endpoints form part of the Atlas B0 source index; presence in this archive is not coverage.
No FAERS quarterly history; that corpus is published separately as faers-live-20260821.
No credential-gated or private source files.
